# Bossidian

Bossidian is a modern dark theme with refined contrast, clean typography and cohesive interface styling. Its Sass sources can be edited for live style updates, which supports rapid visual tweaks during theme development.

![Bossidian screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bosselijah/bossidian/HEAD/images/image-1-small.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Bossidian"
    author: "bosselijah"
    repo:   "bosselijah/bossidian"
    slug:   "bossidian"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/bossidian"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/bosselijah/bossidian"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bosselijah/bossidian/HEAD/images/image-1-small.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply a modern dark theme to Obsidian with refined contrast, clean typography, and cohesive interface styling. Edit Sass files for live style updates and rapid visual tweaks during theme development."
}
```
